summary: Tested backend sportshub regressions and frontend Astra replay/2D surfaces. Backend passed 22/22. Frontend replay library, modal/back/escape, responsive widths, and 12 expanded 2D surfaces passed. Native JVM/assemble rerun was blocked by missing Android SDK path in this container, though existing /tmp/replays-build.log shows prior assembleDebug success.

integration_issues.issue: Gradle failed at configuration: SDK location not found for ANDROID_HOME=/tmp/v2-android-sdk (directory missing in this runtime), so current-iteration native unit execution could not be completed.

action_items: Re-provision Android SDK path in container (or provide valid sdk.dir) and rerun :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug for this iteration's native verification.
Run/update native transport regression specifically asserting Media3 OkHttpDataSource byte-read over HTTPS->HTTP cross-host redirects and non-2xx failure behavior.
Re-run full native suite after the SportsNativeLayoutRobolectricTest native-only update to confirm green in CI/runtime.
critical_code_review_comments: SportsNativeLayoutRobolectricTest had stale assertions for removed browser/fallback internals; updated test now asserts native-only SportsSceneView tree (GamePlotView + overlays, no WebView).

SportsReplayTransport configuration looks aligned with requested policy: single shared OkHttpClient, followRedirects/followSslRedirects enabled, callTimeout=0 for long stream calls, UA set via repository/data source.
Current tests cover Range header and credential rewriting, but explicit DataSource-level redirect byte-read assertions are not clearly present in the checked test files.

rca of the issue: Native rerun blocker reproduction: execute gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug with ANDROID_HOME=/tmp/v2-android-sdk from /app/android/onnowtv-livetv -> failure 'SDK location not found'. Root cause in this environment: expected SDK directory absent. Mitigation: restore/provide valid SDK path (ANDROID_HOME/ANDROID_SDK_ROOT or local.properties sdk.dir), then rerun native suite. Additional note: in frontend canvas play-step check, 'next-play' appeared unchanged only because initial state is already last play (button disabled); moving to previous play confirmed pixel/state changes.
